ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; pixel distribution is approximately 97% low-intensity (black/dark grey) with 3% high-intensity (white) clusters localized at the distal tips and surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black region across 95%+ of both lobes; high-contrast white circular clusters (0.5-2.0% of area) are mapped to the extreme lateral fluke tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped central depression with an internal pixel angle of approximately 30 degrees and a vertical depth comprising approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serrations across the entire trailing edge; left lobe displays a significant secondary notch approximately one-third of the distance from the center; right lobe displays smaller, high-amplitude peaks (5-10 pixels in height).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: S-shaped curve on both lobes, exhibiting slight convexity near the median notch transitioning into a roughly linear, upward-sloping trajectory toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel aggregates (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the lateral terminal edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the left lobe, varying in orientation from diagonal to horizontal.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white horizontal scar located on the left lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch boundary.
